title: Fynkel blend space
description: `<name>.blend.json` (blueprint §19.2d item 19c): a 1D blend space — animation clips placed along one named parameter. An `fynkel.Animator` plays the document like a clip (`clip: { asset: <blend> }`); the world blends the two points around the parameter's value at the fraction between them, phase-synced (each clip is sampled at the same fraction of its own length, so a walk and a run keep their feet together), and a behaviour drives it with `animation.setParameter(<parameter>, value)`. The value is clamped to the first and last point; markers come from the dominant clip; a crossfade out of the space fades its dominant clip.

parameter.description: The parameter the space reads: the name a behaviour sets with `setParameter` (`speed`).

points.description: The clips along the parameter, in strictly increasing `at`: the clip that plays alone when the parameter is exactly `at`. At least one; at most 16.

at.description: The parameter value the clip sits at.

clip.description: An animation clip: a rig's `anim/<name>` or an imported model's `anim/<n>`.

sync.description: How the clips share a clock. `phase`: the blend's clock runs over a length interpolated between the two active clips' and each clip is sampled at the same phase of its own.
